headline: AURUM CONVERGES, WORKFLOWS GO LIVE
summary: This week moved from queue infrastructure into active Aurum system work: BoxBrain merged guarded Git-to-local and Copilot lanes, Codelation and Aurum live-graph/self-review/storage pieces, then converged GUI, local LLM, PC, Pi3, and distributed self-build paths behind same-commit virtual-hardware gates. A Pi3 runtime release was published from converged virtual proof, while aurum.arkmatx.com and the Help Aurum onboarding page were deployed through the existing Bluehost carrier. ArkmatX's rendered-room frontend itself stayed stable aside from telemetry.

projects.name: ARKMATX
projects.detail: The rendered workshop/server/paradox frontend remains the current baseline; no new ArkmatX visual-feature PR merged during Aug 10-16. The repository continued status refreshes and also served as the successful deployment carrier for the separate Aurum web node and Help Aurum page.

projects.name: AURUM
projects.detail: Aurum's PC, Pi3, GUI, local LLM, and distributed self-build paths were converged behind same-commit verification. PR #28 recorded 40-lane native convergence plus Docker x86_64, Docker ARM64, QEMU x86_64 UEFI, and QEMU Pi3 runtime proof and published Pi3 runtime 0.03.1; later trunk work added upgrade-safe installed self-build, duplicate-work guards, context-exchange foundations, state-authority rules, and autonomous-driver-synthesis architecture. Virtual proof is not treated as physical-hardware proof.

projects.name: BOXBRAIN
projects.detail: Merged work added guarded WLAN/rescue handling, provider-aware GitHub Copilot offload, preservation of live Pi assessment routes, a safe Git-to-local Codex bridge, the passive Codelation seed, bounded Aurum live graph/dialogue/local-lane bootstrap, iterative self-review, and Aurum Field v0 storage.

projects.name: AI WORKFLOWS
projects.detail: The Git-to-local watcher was live-tested healthy with exactly-once bounded execution, and two guarded GitHub Copilot dispatches completed without automatic changes. Aurum's self-review path uses explicit keep/revise proposals, one-version promotion, compatibility checks, rollback history, and no automatic host authority; self-learning system references and public-interface notes were also added.

projects.name: WEBSITE CLUSTER
projects.status: AURUM WEB NODE LIVE / FALLBACK CARRIER VERIFIED
projects.detail: ClusterSites added the Aurum Arkmatx runtime and routing, but its first dedicated Bluehost deployment workflow failed. The existing wetbeard-site Bluehost carrier then successfully deployed the Aurum portal/work-leasing path and later the Help Aurum onboarding page, with live verification succeeding on the wetbeard-site workflow.

projects.name: MEDIA STORAGE

weekly_log: Aug 10: BoxBrain merged guarded WLAN inventory and one-shot rescue handling, provider-aware GitHub Copilot workflow optimization, and preservation of live Pi assessment-result routes; the Copilot lane recorded two guarded dispatches with no automatic changes.

Aug 12: BoxBrain merged the passive Codelation learning seed and a safe Git-to-local Codex bridge whose scheduled watcher was installed, health-checked, and live-tested with exactly-once bounded execution.

Aug 12-13: Aurum gained a bounded live graph, first-use dialogue/self-build, a pinned local deployment lane with seed recovery, one-command bootstrap, iterative self-review, and Aurum Field v0 relation-first storage with tests and documented semantics.

Aug 12-14: The Aurum web node, portal, work-leasing/worker path, BBPI4 swarm seeding, and Help Aurum contributor onboarding were deployed through the existing wetbeard-site Bluehost carrier; the Help Aurum deployment workflow completed successfully.

Aug 13: Self-learning AI research references, public-interface notes, and an Aurum integration architecture were added to BoxBrain; these are documented architecture/research work, not claims of a finished self-learning model.

Aug 15: PR #28 converged the distributed native self-build farm with the four-target virtual hardware gate and published Aurum Pi3 runtime 0.03.1; PRs #29 and #31 then converged GUI, local LLM, PC, Pi3, and self-build paths into the Aurum trunk.

Aug 15: Trunk hardening made live self-build state upgrade-safe, gated x86 images on an installed self-build smoke, eliminated duplicate x64 Capacity Mesh test work, and retired a superseded capacity-mesh workflow branch to prevent duplicate hosted execution.

Aug 16: Aurum added a verified ordered context-exchange foundation, state-authority/memory-hierarchy documentation, autonomous-driver-synthesis architecture, continuous non-mutating trunk watchdog logic, and a verified BBPI4 host-key trust update.
easter_egg_seed: Forty lanes agreed on one commit; the forty-first only asked who remembered it.
